content: {"like": ["Good DVD release with many deleted scenes, commentary, music video, and featurettes", "Flipper disc with widescreen on one side and full screen on the other", "Rats are convincing threats and the best part of the remake"], "dislike": ["Remake doesn't allow Willard to evolve and is creepy from the start", "Almost everyone is creepy, including Mr. Martin, his secretary, Willard's mother, and the rats", "Overkill with rats, especially the elevator scene which feels cartoonish", "Scene where Willard puts Chloe the cat with the rats spoils the tone with a video montage of the song Ben", "Ending is different and not in a good way, changed before release, less appropriate than the original", "Overall, the remake is far inferior to the original"]}
